studies.title: Ptolemy's Geography in Latin
studies.caption: In Florence, Jacopo Angeli finishes a Latin translation of Ptolemy's Geography, a book the Greek scholar Manuel Chrysoloras had brought from Constantinople.
studies.prompt: Over-shoulder manuscript workshop in Florence around1408: scholar in plain early fifteenth-century robe compares a Greek handwritten codex with a fresh Latin manuscript, quill poised above page. Columns of tiny indistinct ink strokes and a few coordinate-like marks, dividers and simple ruler nearby. Focus careful translation between books; no printing press, printed atlas, modern world map, spectacles with modern frames or legible fabricated text.
